schema:
CREATE TABLE Customers (
  Address,
  City,
  ContactName,
  Country,
  CustomerID,
  CustomerName,
  PostalCode
);

CREATE TABLE Employees (
  BirthDate,
  EmployeeID,
  FirstName,
  LastName,
  Notes,
  Photo
);

CREATE TABLE Orders (
  CustomerID,
  EmployeeID,
  OrderDate,
  OrderID,
  ShipperID
);

CREATE TABLE Products (
  CategoryID,
  Price,
  ProductID,
  ProductName,
  SupplierID,
  Unit
);

CREATE TABLE Suppliers (
  Address,
  City,
  ContactName,
  Country,
  Phone,
  PostalCode,
  SupplierID,
  SupplierName
);
